## What he does

Yaqub ships production frontends, not demos. Strongest on React, TypeScript and React Router v7 (Remix-style SSR loaders), plus Next.js, Tailwind CSS, i18n/RTL (English, Arabic, Kurdish), Laravel APIs, checkout/payments and web performance. Comfortable owning a frontend end-to-end: architecture, state, accessible UI and real-traffic metrics.

## Tech stack

TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SQL, Python, React, React Router v7, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Sass/SCSS, Bootstrap, i18n/RTL (i18next), Jotai, Redux Toolkit, React Context API, Zod, REST APIs, Firebase, Laravel Echo, Node.js, Django, Django REST Framework, MySQL, Mapbox, Meta Graph API, Git, GitHub, Vite, Webpack, Vercel, Lighthouse, Sentry, Agile/Scrum.

## Experience

1. **Frontend Developer — [iZone Iraq](https://www.izoneiraq.com/)** — Mar 2025 – Present, Full-time, On-site, Erbil
   TypeScript frontend for a multi-brand commerce platform (iZone, OneStore, Apple Zone, Mantiqa, Strap Iraq) serving 15,000+ monthly users. React Router v7, SSR loaders, Tailwind design system, EN/AR/KU RTL, Laravel API, LCP 3.8s → 1.4s, Mapbox + First Iraqi Bank QR checkout, Digital Cards, IMEI lookup, FX rates, community Q&A.

2. **Frontend Developer — [Botolon](https://www.botolon.com/)** — Nov 2023 – Apr 2025, Contract, Remote
   Next.js + Sass + Meta Graph API web client for a chatbot platform serving 50+ business accounts. Visual conversation-flow builder, analytics dashboard, shared component library, sub-100ms interaction latency.
